items.title: Show HN: AI that builds travel itineraries from booking confirmations
items.raw_excerpt: We’ve developed an AI-powered feature for our travel software that automatically builds structured itineraries from raw booking confirmations. Travel agencies and tour operators often receive dozens of emails from multiple suppliers — each with different formats. Our AI model parses these confirmations, detects flights, hotels, activities, and creates a clean digital itinerary with day-by-day structure, ready to share with travelers via mobile, web, or PDF. It’s built on AWS Lambda, OpenAI Responses API, and multi-step function calling with custom JSON schemas. We had to overcome challenges like handling inconsistent data formats, time zones, and merging multi-source bookings without duplication.

items.title: 宇树科技王兴兴：中国企业在全球科技版图中扮演纽带角色
items.raw_excerpt: “中国企业，尤其是科技企业，一直是连接全世界的一个很好的纽带。”宇树科技股份有限公司首席执行官、中国贸促会企业家代表团成员王兴兴表示，中国科技企业既学习世界先进经验，也在开放共享中贡献中国的解决方案。王兴兴在韩国庆州举行的亚太经合组织(APEC)领导人非正式会议期间受访时作上述表示。王兴兴指出，当前全球面临经济复苏与技术变革的双重挑战，人工智能(AI)驱动的机器人产业被普遍视为未来最具潜力的增长引擎。他表示，AI驱动的机器人产业正成为推动亚太乃至全球经济增长的重要力量。“如果通用型人工智能模型实现突破，那将像电力或蒸汽机的发明一样，推动人类文明进入新的阶段。”（中新网）

title_i18n.zh: 宇树科技王兴兴：中国企业在全球科技版图中扮演纽带角色
title_i18n.en: Unitree Robotics Wang Xingxing: Chinese enterprises serve as a bridge in the global technology landscape.
title_i18n.es: Yushu Technology Wang Xingxing: Las empresas chinas desempeñan un papel de nexo en el panorama tecnológico global.

excerpt_i18n.zh: “中国企业，尤其是科技企业，一直是连接全世界的一个很好的纽带。”宇树科技股份有限公司首席执行官、中国贸促会企业家代表团成员王兴兴表示，中国科技企业既学习世界先进经验，也在开放共享中贡献中国的解决方案。王兴兴在韩国庆州举行的亚太经合组织(APEC)领导人非正式会议期间受访时作上述表示。王兴兴指出，当前全球面临经济复苏与技术变革的双重挑战，人工智能(AI)驱动的机器人产业被普遍视为未来最具潜力的增长引擎。他表示，AI驱动的机器人产业正成为推动亚太乃至全球经济增长的重要力量。“如果通用型人工智能模型实现突破，那将像电力或蒸汽机的发明一样，推动人类文明进入新的阶段。”（中新网）
excerpt_i18n.en: Chinese enterprises, particularly in the technology sector, have consistently served as a strong link connecting the world. Wang Xingxing, CEO of Yushu Technology Co., Ltd. and a member of the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade Entrepreneurs Delegation, noted that Chinese tech firms learn from global advanced practices while contributing China's solutions through openness and sharing. He made these remarks during an interview at the APEC Leaders' Informal Meeting in Gyeongju, South Korea. Wang pointed out that the world currently faces dual challenges of economic recovery and technological transformation, with the AI-driven robotics industry widely seen as the most promising growth engine for the future. He stated that this industry is becoming a key force driving economic growth in the Asia-Pacific region and globally. If breakthroughs are achieved in general artificial intelligence models, it could propel human civilization into a new phase, akin to the invention of electricity or the steam engine.
excerpt_i18n.es: Las empresas chinas, especialmente las tecnológicas, han sido un excelente vínculo para conectar con el mundo entero, afirmó Wang Xingxing, consejero delegado de Yushu Technology Co., Ltd. y miembro de la delegación empresarial del Consejo Chino para el Fomento del Comercio Internacional. Las empresas tecnológicas chinas aprenden de las experiencias avanzadas mundiales y también contribuyen con soluciones chinas mediante la apertura y el intercambio. Wang Xingxing hizo estas declaraciones en una entrevista durante la reunión informal de líderes de APEC celebrada en Gyeongju, Corea del Sur. Señaló que actualmente el mundo enfrenta el doble desafío de la recuperación económica y la transformación tecnológica, y la industria robótica impulsada por la inteligencia artificial es ampliamente considerada como el motor de crecimiento con mayor potencial futuro. Afirmó que la industria robótica impulsada por la IA se está convirtiendo en un impulsor clave.

items.title: RTE2025：从“连接”到“对话”，对话式 AI 驱动 RTE 产业跃迁之路
items.raw_excerpt: 10月31日，由声网与 RTE 开发者社区联合主办的 Convo AI & RTE 2025 第十一届实时互联网大会在北京正式开幕。本届大会以“AI 有声”为主题，汇聚了全球顶级的 RTE&对话式 AI 专家、开发者、企业代表与生态伙伴，共同探讨实时互动（RTE）与对话式 AI (Convo AI) 深度融合的新场景、新架构与新机遇。 在主论坛上，声网创始人兼 CEO 赵斌、微软（中国）首席技术官韦青、Agora 联合创始人 Tony Wang 等嘉宾分别带来主题演讲和圆桌讨论。 赵斌：RTE 服务量首破万亿分钟，对话式 AI 将成为下一代 AI Infra 重要部分 在今年的 RTE 2025 实时互联网大会开场演讲中，声网创始人兼 CEO 赵斌宣布， 声网年度服务分钟数首次突破1万亿分钟，标志着 RTE 技术已成为不可或缺的关键基础设施。 与此同时，视频高清化比例在过去两年增长超过10倍，海外市场720p 以上分辨率流量占比已超 80%，WebRTC 全球搜索热度呈现爆发式增长，这一切标志着实时互动行业正迎来新一轮创新热潮。  然而，在基础设施日趋完善的同时，产业依然面临着从"连通"到"对话"的本质挑战。当交互对象从“人与人” 扩展到 “人与AI”，实时互动在环境感知与交互自然度上仍存在明显缺陷。行业数据显示，仅21%的用户对现有 AI 对话体验满意，部分服务的用户流失率高到“不可接受”。 究其根源，人类对话中仅有7%的信息来自语言内容，超过90%的信息感知依赖于语调、表情和肢体语言等非语言要素。要实现真正的“类人对话”，企业必须系统性攻

excerpt_i18n.en: On October 31, the 11th Real-Time Internet Conference, Convo AI & RTE 2025, jointly organized by Agora and the RTE Developer Community, officially opened in Beijing. Themed "AI with Sound," the event brought together top global RTE and conversational AI experts, developers, corporate representatives, and ecosystem partners to explore new scenarios, architectures, and opportunities in the deep integration of real-time engagement (RTE) and conversational AI (Convo AI). At the main forum, keynote speeches and panel discussions were delivered by guests including Zhao Bin, founder and CEO of Agora; Wei Qing, CTO of Microsoft China; and Tony Wang, co-founder of Agora. Zhao Bin announced that Agora's annual service minutes exceeded 1 trillion for the first time, highlighting RTE technology as an essential infrastructure, while conversational AI is set to become a key part of the next-generation AI infrastructure. Additionally, the proportion of high-definition video has increased over tenfold in the past two years, with overseas markets seeing more than 720p resolution traffic accounting for a significant share.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 31 de octubre, se inauguró oficialmente en Pekín la undécima Conferencia de Internet en Tiempo Real Convo AI & RTE 2025, organizada conjuntamente por Agora y la comunidad de desarrolladores RTE. Bajo el tema "AI con voz", el evento reunió a expertos, desarrolladores, representantes empresariales y socios ecológicos líderes mundiales en RTE e IA conversacional para explorar nuevos escenarios, arquitecturas y oportunidades de la integración profunda entre la interacción en tiempo real (RTE) y la IA conversacional (Convo AI).
